name: Westin Foods
old_description: OMAHA, NE - - Westin Foods announced that it has purchased Mr. Dell Foods, Inc., of Kearney, MO.  Mr. Dell Foods is a leading manufacturer of frozen hash browns, sold to grocers, food manufacturers, and foodservice companies.  Mr. Dell’s brand has a loyal national following and is known for its one-ingredient, frozen, shredded hash browns.
about:
Westin Foods operates from Omaha, Nebraska, where it has been in the packaged food business since the 1960s. The company was founded by Dick Westin and remains a privately held family business with no outside investors, now led by Owner and CEO Scott Carlson. The firm also operates Westin Capital Group, an investment division that partners with sole proprietorships and family-owned brands to bring products to market.

The company manufactures a range of food products spanning from bacon to eggplant, marketing its own brands while also producing private label items for many of America's well-known food brands. In a recent expansion, Westin Foods acquired Mr. Dell Foods of Kearney, Missouri, a manufacturer of frozen shredded hash browns sold to grocers, food manufacturers, and foodservice operators. The acquisition adds a nationally recognized, single-ingredient frozen potato line to Westin's portfolio.

Westin Foods serves retail grocery chains, foodservice distributors, and food manufacturers. Its customer base includes national brands that rely on the company for private label production, as well as foodservice operators and grocery retailers carrying Mr. Dell's hash browns. The company emphasizes a dependable supply chain and responsiveness to shifting consumer trends.

Westin Foods says it differentiates itself through a strategy built on people, products, and brands, combining proven business methods with creative approaches to overlooked opportunities. The firm highlights its collaborative model — investing in and growing partner brands — and its commitment to exceeding customer expectations through quality, innovation, and value.
